test_title: PYST 22 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 20 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: A can complete a work in 10 days, and B can complete the same work in 15 days. If they work together, how many days will they take to complete the work?
solution:
A’s one day work = 1/10

B’s one day work = 1/15

Working together, one day work = 1/10 + 1/15

Taking LCM 30:

= 3/30 + 2/30

= 5/30

= 1/6

So, they will complete the work in **6 days.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
